en.review.sentinelone.sentinelone.is.a.full: SentinelOne is a fully autonomous endpoint protection platform that uses AI to prevent, detect, and respond to threats in real-time without human intervention. Its behavioral AI engine can identify and stop attacks at machine speed.
en.review.sentinelone.purple.ai.launched.in: Purple AI, launched in 2023, brings generative AI to security operations. It allows analysts to hunt for threats, investigate incidents, and take action using natural language queries—dramatically reducing mean time to respond.
en.review.sentinelone.a.unique.differentiat: A unique differentiator is SentinelOne's ransomware rollback capability, which can automatically restore encrypted files to their pre-attack state, providing a safety net against ransomware attacks.
en.review.sentinelone.generative.ai.analyst: Generative AI analyst for natural language threat hunting and automated investigation.
en.review.sentinelone.automatically.restore: Automatically restore encrypted files to pre-attack state without backup dependency.
en.review.sentinelone.ai-driven.response.ac: AI-driven response actions execute in milliseconds without human approval.
en.review.sentinelone.automatically.correla: Automatically correlates events into attack narratives for faster understanding.
en.review.sentinelone.unified.platform.exte: Unified platform extending protection to cloud, identity, and network.
en.review.sentinelone.security.data.lake.fo: Security data lake for long-term retention and advanced hunting capabilities.
Smaller threat intel team than CrowdStrike

en.review.sentinelone.cnapp.for.cloud.workl: CNAPP for cloud workloads. Per-workload pricing
SentinelOne training programs provide hands-on knowledge of autonomous endpoint protection, EDR, and threat hunting. These credentials validate skills in next-generation antivirus and behavioral AI protection.
en.review.sentinelone.highest.level.of.expe: Highest level of expertise among SentinelOne Partner cybersecurity engineers. Requires 47+ hours of training and CTF challenge.
en.review.sentinelone.technical.mastery.and: Technical mastery and sales skills for running successful proof-of-concepts and SentinelOne deployments.

ja.review.sentinelone.purple.ai.launched.in: 2023年に発表されたPurple AIは、生成型AIをセキュリティ運用にもたらします。自然言語クエリを使用してアナリストが脅威を検索し、インシデントを調査し、対応を取ることを可能にし、平均応答時間を大幅に短縮します。

ja.review.sentinelone.generative.ai.analyst: 自然言語脅威ハンティングと自動化調査のための生成型AI分析官。
ja.review.sentinelone.automatically.restore: バックアップの依存性なしに、暗号化されたファイルを攻撃前の状態に自動的に復元します。
ja.review.sentinelone.ai-driven.response.ac: AI駆動の応答アクションはミリ秒単位で実行され、人間の承認は不要です。
ja.review.sentinelone.automatically.correla: イベントを攻撃ナラティブに自動的に関連付けて、より速い理解を実現します。
ja.review.sentinelone.unified.platform.exte: クラウド、アイデンティティ、ネットワークへの保護を拡張する統合プラットフォーム。
ja.review.sentinelone.security.data.lake.fo: 長期保持と高度なハンティング機能のためのセキュリティデータレイク。
